thread:
maya: Heads up — main turned red right after the merge (commit rwd-frontend@abc123). Smoke allocator step failing consistently :frowning: Can someone grab?
ci-bot: [CI] Pipeline #8342 failed on branch main. Failed step: smoke-allocator. Logs: <https://ci.redwood.example/pipelines/8342/logs/smoke-allocator> ▸ exit code 1
omar: on it, pulling logs now.
jen: @maya @ryan ping — any known risky changes from the merge? :eyes:
maya: @ryan landed two PRs, one was docs but the other was a deps bump (libkvc v2.1.0).
ryan: I merged the deps bump (sha: def456). It was supposed to be minor. I didn't touch allocator code.
omar: quick grep of logs shows: "kvcache: allocation failed: reserved bytes exceeded" — looks like allocator behavior changed.
jen: can we /rerun the failing step first to be sure it's deterministic? If it passes, could be flake.
maya: running: `/rerun pipeline 8342 --step smoke-allocator`
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by maya: Pipeline #8342 (smoke-allocator). Rerun id: 8342.2
ci-bot: Rerun completed — smoke-allocator FAILED again. Same error: "reserved bytes exceeded".
omar: not a flake. Suggest doing a bisect between last-green (5076501200) and current head to narrow commit. I can start git-bisect if we want.
jen: or quick rollback of the deps bump (def456) to confirm. Revert would be fastest to get main green.
ryan: I can open a revert PR in 5m. If that fixes CI we merge and then do a calm bisect on my branch.
alice: +1 to revert to restore CI. We shouldn't do wide rollbacks but immediate green is higher priority.
maya: ok plan: ryan opens revert PR, omar will bisect in parallel if revert doesn't fix it. Jen, can you watch the canary queue after revert?
jen: yep, I'll watch canaries and run a short smoke matrix after revert merge.
omar: starting bisect harness now (local infra). Will report every 20 mins.
ryan: opened revert PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwd/pull/4532> — adding as hotfix label. Please review fast.
maya: adding owner rotation: @ryan will push revert, @omar will continue bisect, @jen watches canaries. I'll update status in #incidents if revert merges. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR 4532 triggered CI: pipeline #8345. Smoke-allocator queued.
ci-bot: Pipeline #8345 completed — smoke-allocator PASSED.
jen: canaries looked good for 10 mins, no regressions showing.
omar: bisect halted, looks like revert fixed it — likely caused by the deps bump. I'll follow up with a smaller repro and a test added to the smoke-suite.
maya: great work, thanks all. Follow-up: add a unit test for allocator reservation edge so this doesn't slip. I'll file a ticket. :white_check_mark:
